title: MoTE: Mixture of Task Experts for Multi-Task Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2608.24763v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Procedural video-language models must solve heterogeneous tasks from the same visual evidence, including action recognition, forecasting, and procedure prediction. Dense transformer decoders share the same feed-forward networks across tasks, which can entangle task behavior and make controlled capability expansion difficult. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) decoders provide conditional computation, but token-level learned routing is not naturally aligned with task-level procedural objectives. We propose MoTE (Mixture of Task Experts), a decoder architecture that converts large language model feed-forward networks into task-specific experts while keeping the multimodal backbone shared. Each example follows one sample-level task route, so active task-expert computation remains independent of the number of stored task experts. We instantiate this design as VideoLLM-MoTE and evaluate it on five COIN benchmarks using explicit task routes. Th

translated_title: MoTE：面向多任务视频理解的任务专家混合模型
translated_abstract: 程序性视频语言模型必须从相同的视觉证据中解决异构任务，包括动作识别、预测和程序预测。密集的Transformer解码器在不同任务间共享相同的前馈网络，这可能导致任务行为相互纠缠，并使受控能力扩展变得困难。稀疏的专家混合（MoE）解码器提供了条件计算，但令牌级别的学习路由并不自然地与任务级别的程序性目标对齐。我们提出了MoTE（任务专家混合），这是一种解码器架构，它将大型语言模型的前馈网络转换为特定任务的专家，同时保持多模态骨干网络共享。每个示例遵循一条样本级别的任务路由，因此活动任务专家计算与存储的任务专家数量无关。我们将此设计实例化为VideoLLM-MoTE，并使用显式任务路由在五个COIN基准上对其进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出MoTE解码器架构，通过将前馈网络转化为任务专属专家并采用样本级路由，实现多任务视频理解的高效解耦和可扩展性，优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MoTE, a decoder architecture that converts feed-forward networks into task-specific experts with sample-level routing, enabling efficient task decoupling and scalability for multi-task video understanding.
